title: Ross Coulthart gets Brent to name Harrington on camera

tellings.quote: 19 or 20 or something when Ross Coldart got me on camera and just pushed me so

plain: Around 2019 or 2020, the journalist Ross Coulthart pressed Brent Friedman on camera until Friedman named a man called Harrington in connection with a UFO story. Friedman tells Michels this happened to him, saying Coulthart "got me on camera and just pushed me." He also names Bryce Zabel in connection with the story. He tells it to explain how a name he had held back came out in public.
